minutes-to-hours.title: divide minutes by 60
minutes-to-hours.explanation: There are 60 minutes in an hour. A fraction of an hour is not written like clock time.
minutes-to-hours.guidance: For a speed in km/h, convert minutes to hours before using the formula.

speed-formula.title: speed = distance ÷ time
speed-formula.explanation: Speed tells you how far something travels per unit of time.
speed-formula.guidance: Divide distance by time for speed; multiply speed by time for distance; divide distance by speed for time.

average-speed.title: total distance and total time
average-speed.explanation: Average speed describes the whole journey, even if speeds vary.
average-speed.guidance: Add all distances and all elapsed times, including stops when requested. Divide the totals.
examples: 60 km in 1 hour then 40 km in 1 hour gives 100 ÷ 2 = 50 km/h.
